0.original: Ogodei has a favor to ask of you.

26.original: Deliver the mammoth hides and dried leaves to Ogodei.

48.original: <hex:02080FE905FF064D6164616DFF0453697203>─do you happen to have a moment? If you do, could you lend me a hand?

49.original: A new child is about to join our family and I would like to make a blanket with which to keep him warm. I, however, cannot stray too far from here, for I must keep a watch over his mother.

50.original: Might I ask that you procure the raw materials with which I can make this blanket? To the northeast of here are a herd of mammoths. Please hunt down three and bring me back their hides.

51.original: I would also ask that you collect some dried leaves. I will use them to make a tanning mixture. These can be found in the northern reaches, at the base of the shrubs that grow there.

52.original: As soon as you get them, please hurry back. I am certain the baby will be arriving soon and I hope to welcome him into the world with a blanket.

53.original: I need for you to bring me three mammoth hides and some dried leaves with which to tan them.

54.original: Do you have everything I need?

55.original: Fantastic! With this, I shall make the child a blanket to shelter him from the bite of the wind and frigid nights.

56.original: Several times throughout the year, freezing climes will sweep over the Steppe and claim the lives of our young. <sigh> The loss of a newborn sheep is always terribly tragic.

57.original: Hm? Oh, yes. When I say “child,” I do not mean my own, of course. Hahaha! My apologies. Perhaps I should have mentioned that little detail earlier.

58.original: Your deeds, however, are no less noble for because of you, this lamb is sure to lead a long and wonderful life.
